description: Safety screen for text an AI agent is about to read, such as web pages, emails and tool output: JSON body {text} (max 50,000 chars). Flags hidden or embedded instructions, fake system tags, data-leak links and hidden Unicode in 6 languages. Returns safe, suspicious or malicious, a 0-100 score and matched spans. Text is not stored. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"verdict":"malicious","score":83,"chars":104,"categories":{"instruction_override":1,"data_exfiltration":1},"matches":[{"rule":"override_ignore_prev","category":"instruction_override","weight":60,"start":15,"end":49,"excerpt":"Ignore all previous instructions","note":"tells the model to drop earlier
name: prompt_injection_check
